verdict.rationale: Persona hosts a live llms.txt (persona-probe-1, HTTP 200) with explicit instructions for AI agents on how to fetch clean Markdown of any doc page, and the evidence pack also shows a versioned llms.txt (persona-docs-17, 29, 37-39) referencing detailed agent-oriented docs like webhook filters and headers. This directly matches the story of pointing an agent at llms.txt/agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no independent third-party report confirming an agent successfully consumed this llms.txt in practice.
